label: qwen38-mac-mtplx-2.7.1-d2-review32k
reason: MTPLX has no tokenize endpoint, so the harness used a character estimate calibrated for a different tokenizer. Server logs later proved that the request contained 72,746 prompt tokens, not 32K. The client was interrupted after more than 700 seconds, but the server completed the request in 829.217 seconds.
interpretation: Do not use this as a 32K result. It is retained as evidence of the calibration failure and as an approximately 73K cold-context observation. Corrected runs use an explicit fixture-module count calibrated from server usage.
